reproducibleInstrument.definition: exact TopSet_D2 and exact TopSet_D3 are disjoint

secondaryContext.study: State Space / Game Tree Complexity Study 1

mechanism.name: D2-to-D3 root-best-instability-conditioned root TT-best-first ordering
mechanism.scope: enhanced alpha-beta iterative-deepening root move ordering only
mechanism.runtimeSignal: after completed depth 2 and completed depth 3 in the same analyzeMove call, deterministic selected root move key differs between D2 and D3
mechanism.workerContract: worker already forwards search options; no worker-source change is authorized for v1
mechanism.lifetime: activation state exists only within one analyzeMove call and is never persisted across positions

runtimeTrigger.condition: D2 deterministic selected root move key != D3 deterministic selected root move key
runtimeTrigger.activation: once condition is observed after D3 completion, candidate root TT-first ordering remains active for subsequent completed-depth attempts in the same analyzeMove call
notTriggeredFor: D2/D3 deterministic selected root move unchanged

orderingPlacement.candidatePriority: at root ply only, use the current transposition-table preferred move as TT-first for depths >=4 after activation
orderingPlacement.priorityPosition: immediate-win first, then candidate root TT preferred, then captured-seed ordering, then baseline non-TT preferred/killer/history/static ordering
orderingPlacement.existingTtMoveFirstCompatibility: if baseline option ttMoveFirst=true already gives the same root preferred-move priority, candidate activation must be idempotent and introduce no additional ordering class

candidateSpecificPopulation.source: frozen PBAI-C decision-quality root populations; no Research Generation 1 formal state is reused as an engineering outcome
candidateSpecificPopulation.populationSelection: existing outcome/value-blind PBAI-C deterministic hash materialization with authoritative RAW identity including pending

primaryTarget.definition: exact TopSet_D2 and exact TopSet_D3 are disjoint
primaryTarget.selection: eligible roots in frozen population hash order
primaryTarget.insufficientFutureSupportAction: NON-ESTIMABLE/HOLD; no source-block or selector replacement after support inspection

boundaryTriggerStratum.definition: exact D2/D3 TopSets overlap but deterministic canonical best move changes
boundaryTriggerStratum.purpose: prospectively audit the runtime trigger surface that is broader than the scientific D23 endpoint; never merge this stratum into primary benefit inference

negativeControl.definition: deterministic canonical best move unchanged from exact D2 to exact D3
negativeControl.purpose: runtime trigger-zero and exact feature-off equivalence control

candidateSpecificBenefitGate.primaryEndpoint: fixed-depth D4 cumulative search-node efficiency on exact D23 TopSet-disjoint target roots with candidate feature on versus feature off
candidateSpecificBenefitGate.measurement: hard enhanced search, maxDepth=4, timeLimitMs=Infinity, evaluationProfile=bao, quiescenceDepth=1; total stats.nodes are cumulative over iterative-deepening depths 1..4

developmentStoppingRule.ifDevelopmentBenefitGateFails: REJECT or HOLD PBAI-C004-v1; a materially different mechanism requires a new candidate version/contract before outcomes
developmentStoppingRule.ifAnySemanticOrGlobalHardGateFails: REJECT/HOLD; node efficiency or strength may not offset failure

validationAndHoldoutFirewall.releaseHoldoutAuthorizationCondition: candidate source/config hash frozen after fresh validation PASS plus explicit PBAI-F authorization
